source_analysis.reusable_architecture: A narrator waits in an ordinary place, initially dismisses an unfamiliar object or practice, observes it closely, encounters an unexpected revealing moment, and leaves with a revised judgment.
copyright_risk_notes: Do not reuse a veterinarian, cat, iguana, pet owner, rainforest imagery, animal affection, or source dialogue.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: A narrator observing restoration of an old theater sign and discovering its layered civic history
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Dismiss a damaged sign as scrap; watch a conservator reveal earlier lettering; understand the marks as evidence of changing neighborhood uses; leave seeing wear as a record.

blueprints.new_topic_domain: A narrator helping a coastal weather club launch an instrument kite
blueprints.rhetorical_arc: Dismiss the kite as a toy; observe wind cues and a failed launch; help adjust and relaunch it; recognize motion as evidence and the kite as a measurement tool.
